src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
s: Who Chaired the 17th BRICS Summit?
x: The 17th BRICS Summit (Rio de Janeiro, 6–7 July 2025) was hosted by Brazil, so it was chaired by Brazil's President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Ramaphosa (South Africa) chaired the 15th (Johannesburg, 2023); Egypt's El-Sisi and Indonesia's Prabowo lead newer members, not the 2025 host.

src: APPSC
s: What was the theme of the 6th BIMSTEC Summit held in April 2025?
o: BIMSTEC: Regional Solidarity for South Asia
x: The 6th BIMSTEC Summit (Bangkok, 4 April 2025, Thailand in the chair) adopted the Bangkok Vision 2030 under the theme "BIMSTEC: Prosperous, Resilient and Open". The other options are invented themes.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Which committee of UNSC designated Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammad Chief Masood Azhar as a global terrorist?
x: Masood Azhar was listed (May 2019) by the UNSC 1267 (ISIL/Da'esh and Al-Qaida) Sanctions Committee, which imposes asset freeze, travel ban and arms embargo; China had blocked the listing for years. The 1540 Committee deals with WMD non-proliferation and the 1373 Counter-Terrorism Committee with general state obligations.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer in Sainik Welfare Service
s: Where was the Earth Summit held?
x: The Earth Summit (UN Conference on Environment and Development, 1992) was held at Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; it adopted the UNFCCC and the CBD. Sweden (Stockholm) hosted the earlier 1972 UN Conference on the Human Environment.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: The meeting of United Nations Inter- Governmental Panel on Climate Change was held in May 2007 at:
x: IPCC Working Group III (mitigation) met at Bangkok, Thailand (30 Apr – 4 May 2007) and approved its part of the Fourth Assessment Report.

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) / Technical Assistan
s: United Nations Conference on Housing and Sustainable Urban Development (Habit III) was held during October, 2016 at
x: Habitat III (UN Conference on Housing and Sustainable Urban Development) met at Quito, Ecuador, 17–20 Oct 2016, and adopted the New Urban Agenda.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Which of the following countries will host the '2nd Global Summit on Earth Science and Climate Change' in September 2020?
x: Printed APPSC key kept: Czech Republic (Prague) for this privately organised scientific conference; no record of the 2020 event could be found to confirm it.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: On 13 January 2020, the World Future Energy Summit was held at:
x: The World Future Energy Summit is held each January at Abu Dhabi during Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week; the 2020 edition opened on 13 Jan 2020.

src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector General Studies & Me
s: Which country hosted the Summit for a New Global Financing Pact on 22 and 23 June 2023?
x: France (Paris, President Macron) hosted the Summit for a New Global Financing Pact on 22–23 June 2023.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers 2020 (13-03-2020)
s: The 8th Asia Pacific Broadcasting Union (ABU) Media Summit on Climate Action and Disaster Preparedness was held in 2019 at ____
x: The ABU Media Summit on Climate Action and Disaster Preparedness of 2019 was held at Kathmandu, Nepal (Radisson Hotel, 25–26 April 2019), adopting the Kathmandu Media Action Plan; ABU numbers it the 5th edition, not the 8th.

src: TREI-RB JL & DL (S1) 2023
s:
Read the following statements about the United Nations World Geospatial Information Congress (UNWGIC) which was held in India in October 2022:

A. It was hosted by the Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India.

B. The second congress was held in Hyderabad, India.

C. The theme of the second congress was 'Geo-enabling the global village: No one should be left behind'.

D. The second congress was held for a period of 10 days from 5th to 14th October.
Choose the correct statement(s):
x: The 2nd UN World Geospatial Information Congress was hosted by India's Ministry of Science and Technology at Hyderabad, 10–14 Oct 2022, on 'Geo-enabling the global village: no one should be left behind' (A, B, C). It lasted five days, not ten, so D is wrong.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: In which city was the 3rd Global Conference on Road Safety was held in February 2020?
x: The 3rd Global Ministerial Conference on Road Safety was held at Stockholm, Sweden, 19–20 Feb 2020, and adopted the Stockholm Declaration (halve road deaths by 2030).

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Where did the first global refugee forum take place in December 2019?
x: The first Global Refugee Forum was held in Geneva on 17–18 Dec 2019, co-hosted by UNHCR and Switzerland, under the Global Compact on Refugees.

src: APPSC Group-II Prelims 2017 (26-02-2017)
s: Fifth India-Arab Partnership Conference was held at
x: The 5th India-Arab Partnership Conference was held at Muscat, Oman, on 14–15 Dec 2016, organised by Oman's Foreign Ministry and the Arab League Secretariat with India's MEA, with FICCI and the Oman Chamber of Commerce as coordinators. Dubai (the old key) did not host it.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: The main theme of the Conference of World Parliamentarians held in Dhaka organised jointly by Inter Parliamentary Union and the Bangladesh Jatiya Sangsad recently is
o: Control trans border terrorism: Bilateral negotiations
Settle inter-country river disputes: Amicable negotiations
Redressing Inequalities: Delivering on Dignity and well being for all
x: The 136th IPU Assembly at Dhaka (April 2017), hosted with the Bangladesh Jatiya Sangsad, had the theme 'Redressing Inequalities: Delivering on dignity and well-being for all'.

src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
s: The Third edition of Raisina Dialogue in New Delhi was inaugurated by the Prime Minister of:
x: The third Raisina Dialogue (January 2018, New Delhi) was inaugurated by Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu. Raisina Dialogue is organised by ORF with the MEA since 2016.

src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
s: Theme of Asia Pacific Summit addresses interdependence, mutual prosperity and
x: The Universal Peace Federation's Asia-Pacific Summit (Kathmandu, Nov–Dec 2018) had the theme 'Addressing the Critical Challenges of our Time: Interdependence, Mutual Prosperity and Universal Values'.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Which statement is not correct about International Judicial Conference 2020?
o: It was held in New Delhi
It was addressed by US President Donald Trump.
It aimed to bring upon gender equality in other crucial areas where women have still not earned their recognition
The theme of the conference was: Gender Just World
x:
Printed key / most books: statement 2 (Trump) is the incorrect one. Strictly the overall theme was 'Judiciary and the Changing World'; 'Gender Just World' was one theme on its agenda, so statement 4 is also loose (drishtiias.com).
The International Judicial Conference (Supreme Court of India, New Delhi, 22–23 Feb 2020) was addressed by PM Modi (inaugural) and President Kovind (valedictory) – not by US President Trump, so statement 2 is the expected 'not correct' answer.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2017
s: Which of the following countries boycotted the recent 'One Belt One Road' summit organized by China?
x: India boycotted China's first Belt and Road Forum (Beijing, May 2017) because the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor passes through Pakistan-occupied Kashmir; the USA, South Korea and Japan sent delegations.

src: APPSC Assistant Section Officer (ASO) Mains General Studies
s: The Third Eastern Economic Forum was held in September, 2017 in Russia at?
x: The Eastern Economic Forum is held every September at Vladivostok (Far Eastern Federal University, Russky Island); the 3rd EEF met there on 6–7 Sep 2017.

src: APPSC Asst. Social, B.C, Tribal Welfare Officers Mains Paper
s: On which issue India refused to sign the "Bali Declaration" of 'World Parliamentary Forum on Sustainable Development' held in Indonesia in September, 2017?
o: Reference to Border dispute between Bhutan and China
Reference to violence in Rakhine State of Myanmar
Reference to Nuclear missile test by North Korea
Reference to OBOR proposal by China
x: India declined to endorse the Bali Declaration of the World Parliamentary Forum on Sustainable Development (Sept 2017) because its reference to violence in Myanmar's Rakhine State was not balanced.

src: AP Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in APBC W
s: Who led the Indian delegation that attended the 'World Parliamentary Forum on Sustainable Development' held in Indonesia recently?
x: Lok Sabha Speaker Sumitra Mahajan led India's delegation to the World Parliamentary Forum on Sustainable Development at Bali (Sept 2017), where India refused to sign the Bali Declaration.

src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer & Analyst Grade-II (A
s: The 'Global Pulse Confederation' (GPC) was held in which country in February 2024?
x: The Global Pulse Confederation's 'Pulses 2024' convention was held in New Delhi, India (Taj Palace, 14–17 Feb 2024), co-hosted with NAFED – the first GPC conference in India after 18 years; the 2023 edition was in Sydney, Australia.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Where did the Biswa Ijtema / World Muslim congregation take place during December 2003, drawing three million devotees from 70 countries?
x: The Biswa Ijtema is held every year at Tongi on the Turag river near Dhaka, Bangladesh; it is called the second-largest Muslim congregation after the Hajj.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: The International Ayurveda Congress, 2017 was held at?
x: The (2nd) International Ayurveda Congress was held in London (Hammersmith), 1–3 April 2017, organised by the All India Ayurvedic Congress, the International Academy of Ayurved and the International Maharishi AyurVeda Foundation; the 1st was at Roermond, Netherlands (2015).

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: What was the theme of the New Delhi World Book Fair, 2017 held in January, 2017?
o: Manushi: Writings on and by Women
Books: Doors opening for the future
x: The New Delhi World Book Fair 2017 (January 2017, organised by the National Book Trust) had the theme 'Manushi' – writings on and by women.

src: APPSC Group-I Prelims 2002
s: Where was the World Council of Religious Leaders summit held in June 2002?
x: The World Council of Religious Leaders (follow-up to the UN Millennium World Peace Summit, 2000) held its first meeting at Bangkok, Thailand, 12–14 June 2002.

src: APPSC Group-I Prelims 2002 (28-03-2002)
s: Where was the conference of the World Council of Religious Leaders held during June 2002?
x: The World Council of Religious Leaders held its first conference at Bangkok, Thailand, 12–14 June 2002 (repeat of the 2002 question).

src: APPSC Group-I Paper-II Screening Test 2019
s: The Global Business Summit 2019 was held in
x: The ET Global Business Summit 2019 (5th edition) was held in New Delhi in February 2019, addressed by PM Modi.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: The International Conclave On "Globalizing Indian Thought" was held from January 16-18, 2020 at:
x: The International Conclave 'Globalizing Indian Thought' (16–18 Jan 2020) was hosted by IIM Kozhikode and inaugurated by Vice-President Venkaiah Naidu.

src: APPSC Group-II Prelims 2017 (26-02-2017)
s: The 77th session of the Indian History Congress was held at
x: The 77th session of the Indian History Congress was held at the University of Kerala, Thiruvananthapuram, 28–30 Dec 2016.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: The World Economic Forum 2025 met in Davos to discuss global co-operation in which area?
x: WEF Annual Meeting 2025 (Davos, Jan 2025; theme 'Collaboration for the Intelligent Age') centred on AI governance alongside climate and growth. Space exploration, public health and sports diplomacy were not its focus.

src: APPSC Group-II Mains 2017 Paper-I (15-07-2017)
s: What was the theme of the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum held in January, 2017 at Davos?
x: WEF Davos 2017 theme: 'Responsive and Responsible Leadership' (Xi Jinping attended). 'Mastering the Fourth Industrial Revolution' was the 2016 theme.

src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2006
s: Where is Davos – the venue of the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum (WEF), located?
x: Davos is a ski resort town in the canton of Graubünden, Switzerland; the WEF itself is based at Cologny near Geneva.

src: U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2021
s: Which of the following organization has launched 'The Great Reset' Initiatives for the recovery of global economy during the Post Covid-19 phase?
x: 'The Great Reset' was launched by the World Economic Forum (and the Prince of Wales) in June 2020 as its post-COVID recovery initiative and was the theme of its 2021 meeting; not the World Bank, OECD or UNCTAD.

src: Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2016
s: Where was the World Economic Forum Meet-2016, organized?
x: The WEF Annual Meeting 2016 was held at Davos-Klosters, Switzerland, in January 2016 (theme 'Mastering the Fourth Industrial Revolution').

src: State PSC
s: Which country hosted the 2023 World Economic forum meeting?
x: The WEF Annual Meeting 2023 (16–20 January) was held at Davos, Switzerland, on 'Cooperation in a Fragmented World'.

src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2024
s: Which one of the following is the correct description of "100 Million Farmers"?
o: It is a platform for accelerating the transition towards food and water systems that are net-zero (carbon), nature-
It is an international alliance and a network of individuals and farming organisations interested in supporting and
It is a digital platform fully integrated with service providers and built on blockchain that lets buyers, sellers and
It is a platform with the mission of encouraging the farmers to form Farmer Product Organisations or Agribusiness
x: 100 Million Farmers is a WEF-initiated multistakeholder platform to speed the transition to net-zero (carbon), nature-positive and resilient food and water systems by 2030. It is not a farmers' alliance, a blockchain marketplace or an FPO-promotion mission.

src: APPSC Executive Officer Gr-III Endowment Paper-I General Stu
s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about the World Economic Forum meeting between 16-20 January 2023?

A. The WEF 2023 meeting was held at Davos in Switzerland.

B. The theme of the WEF 2023 meeting was 'Cooperation in a Fragmented World'.

C. The WEF 2023 meeting was chaired by Gita Gopinath, the Deputy Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
x: The WEF Annual Meeting of 16–20 Jan 2023 was at Davos with the theme 'Cooperation in a Fragmented World' (A, B correct); the IMF's Gita Gopinath was only a panel speaker, not its chair (C wrong).

src: State PSC
s: Which Indian State/UT has been chosen to host the G20 Summit in 2023?
x: India's G20 Presidency (1 Dec 2022 – 30 Nov 2023) culminated in the 18th G20 Leaders' Summit at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi (Delhi), 9–10 Sep 2023, theme 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'. Goa, Gujarat and J&K hosted only G20 working-group meetings.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: In which of the following city the G-20 Summit was held in July, 2017?
x: The 12th G20 Summit was held at Hamburg, Germany, on 7–8 July 2017; Buenos Aires (2018) and Osaka (2019) followed.

src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
s: In which place the G20 Digital Economy Ministerial meeting was held?
x: The G20 Digital Economy Ministerial Meeting of 2018 (Argentina's presidency) was held at Salta, Argentina (August 2018); later ones include Bengaluru, India (August 2023).

src: APPSC AEE Civil & Mechanical Engineering General Studies & M
s: Which of following countries hosted the 13th G-20 Summit?
x: The 13th G20 Summit was held at Buenos Aires, Argentina, 30 Nov – 1 Dec 2018.

src: APPSC Executive Officer Gr-III Endowment Paper-I General Stu
s:
Match the roles in international associations in list-I with the countries in list-II.
List-I:
A. BRICS (2023) Chair
B. G20 (2023) Presidency
C. ASEAN (2023) Chair
D. COP 28 (2023) Host
List-II: i. India ii. South Africa iii. United Arab Emirates iv. Indonesia
x: 2023: BRICS chair South Africa (Johannesburg summit), G20 presidency India (New Delhi summit), ASEAN chair Indonesia, COP28 host UAE (Dubai) – A-ii, B-i, C-iv, D-iii.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
The Global Biofuel Alliance (GBA) was launched on 9th September, 2023 during the G20 Summit. Which among the following non-G20 countries are supporting the Global Biofuel Alliance (GBA)?

I. Paraguay

II. Sri Lanka

III. Guyana

IV. Seychelles

V. Chile

VI. Finland
o: I, II, III, IV and V
II, III, IV, V and VI
I, III, IV, V and VI
I, II, III, IV and VI
x: Non-G20 countries supporting the GBA (launched 9 Sep 2023 at the New Delhi G20 Summit) include Paraguay, Sri Lanka, Guyana, Seychelles and Finland (also Iceland, Kenya, Uganda, UAE); Chile is not one, so I, II, III, IV and VI.

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I
s:
Match
List-I (Environmental Summits/COPs) with
List-II (Places) and choose your answers from the code given below:
List-I:

(a) World Environment Summit-2023

(b) G20 Climate and Environment Ministers Meeting-2023

(c) United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP28)-2023

(d) UN Climate Change Conference (UNFCCC COP 29)-2024
List-II:
(i) Tamil Nadu, India
(ii) Dubai, United Arab Emirates
(iii) Uttar Pradesh, India
(iv) Baku, Azerbaijan
x: COP28 (2023) was at Dubai, UAE and COP29 (2024) at Baku, Azerbaijan; the G20 Climate and Environment Ministers' meeting (July 2023) was at Chennai, Tamil Nadu, leaving Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow) for the 2023 environment summit – only option 3 fits (a-iii, b-i, c-ii, d-iv).

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
s: To which country the Indian government has announced $ 300 billion in loans to strengthen maritime security in the year 2024?
x: India announced two credit lines totalling US$300 million (US$180 m + US$120 m, Exim Bank) for Vietnam's maritime security during PM Pham Minh Chinh's New Delhi visit on 1 Aug 2024 (the stem's 'billion' is a slip for 'million'). Indonesia, Egypt and France got no such loan.

src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
s: In which place the maiden meeting of BRICS Working Group meeting on "Energy Saving and Energy Efficiency" was held?
x: The first meeting of the BRICS Working Group on Energy Saving and Energy Efficiency was held at Visakhapatnam on 4–5 July 2016 under India's BRICS chairship (Union Power Ministry); delegates saw the city's LED street-lighting project.
